coverage_target: High practical coverage of reusable SAP S/4HANA Sales process patterns. Localizations and narrow industry variants are mapped as aliases or adjacent capabilities unless they change a core business/control contract.
decision_rules: Separate a variant when it changes physical flow, stock ownership, supply source, legal entity, inspection/disposition, billing trigger, settlement model, product configuration, or integration evidence.
Map a SAP scope item to an existing author code when it is mainly a packaged best-practice implementation of the same business contract.
Keep cross-cutting capabilities such as ATP, credit, payment, output, TM or EWM as mechanisms/overlays rather than pretending each combination is a new sales process.

scope_aliases.reason: non-stock item with order-specific procurement is the practical order-specific procurement branch
full Customer Returns / Advanced Returns Management pattern
payment overlays rather than new fulfillment branches
sales order processing for sales kits
